trap.label: ordem de porcentagem
trap.wrong: There is a chance of 40% of rain tonight.
trap.right: There is a 40% chance of rain tonight.
trap.why: Em português “40% de chance de chuva” põe o número depois. Em inglês, a porcentagem vem antes de chance.

fix.wrong: The weather front will arrives tonight.
fix.right: The weather front will arrive tonight.

fix.wrong: Winds will be gusty with heavy raining.
fix.right: Winds will be gusty with heavy rain.

fix.wrong: It is likely that will rain.
fix.right: It is likely that it will rain.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “There is a chance of 30% of rain.”
rewrite.answer: There is a 30% chance of rain.
